measurementPolicy.startup: Navigation start to selected synthetic thread and enabled composer; production and dev builds are separate populations.
measurementPolicy.taskSwitch: In-page UI click to the first animation frame with selected thread and enabled composer. automationSwitchMs separately retains runner/CDP round-trip overhead; compare only the same method and engine.
measurementPolicy.memory: Chromium Performance.getMetrics JSHeapUsedSize is a heap proxy, not resident memory. Unsupported metrics are null with a reason; native RSS remains unmeasured.
measurementPolicy.comparison: Future median and nearest-rank p95 must not exceed baseline + max(baseline * 0.05, 20 ms). Resident memory delta ceiling is 15 MiB, pending native measurement.
